question: Under what conditions must this teaching be kept secret in the mortal world?
premises: The teaching must be concealed with effort.
The context of concealment is the mortal world.
The concealment applies especially among the lowest of men.
inference: This teaching requires deliberate secrecy in the mortal world, particularly among unworthy people.
plain_english: It must be carefully concealed in the mortal world among the lowest of men.
